changelog: New voice command: say 'checked checkbox' or 'ticked checkbox' (or 'টিক দেওয়া চেকবক্স' / 'চেক করা চেকবক্স') alone while dictating and a new line with a checked checkbox ☑ starts — mark checklist items already done (bought, packed, finished) instead of leaving every box empty. With Spoken Punctuation on, 'checked checkbox' and 'checked checkbox sign' also work mid-sentence. Undo removes just the box (77 commands in Help & Support > Voice commands). Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
